describe_vpcs: build a python module to describe AWS VPCs by ID or tags using the EC2Gateway class
describe_vpc: build a python module to describe a single AWS VPC by its VPC ID using EC2Gateway
list_vpcs: build a python module to list all AWS VPC IDs in the current region using EC2Gateway
describe_subnets: build a python module to describe AWS subnets filtered by VPC ID or tags using EC2Gateway
describe_security_groups: build a python module to describe AWS security groups as firewall rulesets using EC2Gateway
